description: Defines the base class 'DisplayDriverBase' for creating and managing display shapes in OrchardCore, including methods for initializing, copying, and lazily creating shapes, as well as combining display results.

classes.name: DisplayDriverBase
classes.description: Base class providing methods to initialize, copy, create, and combine display shapes and results in OrchardCore.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Creates a new strongly typed shape with optional initialization.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Creates a new shape by copying properties from an existing model.

methods.name: Dynamic
methods.description: Creates a loosely typed shape with optional asynchronous or synchronous initialization.

methods.name: View
methods.description: Creates a shape view model for a specific model.

methods.name: Shape
methods.description: Creates a shape from an existing IShape instance.

methods.name: Factory
methods.description: Creates a shape lazily using a shape builder function.

methods.name: Combine
methods.description: Combines multiple display results into one.

methods.name: CombineAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously combines multiple display results into one.
